external_spec_note: That a payable token-sale function's distribution amount should presuppose a nonzero payment is derivable directly from the function's own structure (`getTokens() payable`, toGive computed from msg.value); no protocol/business convention beyond the source is needed.
extraction_note: Annotation attaches to line 69 (`distr(investor, toGive);`), the point immediately before toGive is consumed. Bug: `toGive = value + msg.value * 10000000` (line 63, unconditionally executed unless the totalRemaining<=200000000e18 branch overrides it at line 66) never requires msg.value > 0, so a zero-payment call still yields a positive toGive (drawn entirely from the free `value` term) -- confirmed against the debug scenario (msg.value=0, value=5000e18, totalRemaining=8e26 > 2e26 so the line 65-66 override branch is NOT taken in this scenario, toGive keeps its line-63 value). Classified Algorithm-level, not Value-level: the intended computation is missing an entire distinct step (a payment-nonzero precondition/require gate) rather than having one wrong operand within an otherwise-complete expression -- no such gate exists anywhere in getTokens(). Relevant_statements covers both statically-possible definitions of toGive (line 63's unconditional formula and line 66's conditional override, gated by line 65) plus the upstream cap on `value` itself (lines 55-56, `if (value > totalRemaining) { value = totalRemaining; }`, since `value` is an operand of both toGive definitions) and the attachment-point statement itself (line 69); the reachability-only `require(value <= totalRemaining)` (line 59) is excluded (pure boolean gate, doesn't redefine anything). distr() (called at line 69) is not counted as an Additional function: the relation only concerns toGive/msg.value's values immediately before the call, which are already fully determined by that point, so distr()'s internal behavior is not load-bearing to this relation's validity (Step 1 fails) even though the call is the annotation's attachment point. annotation_plans.md's older draft (read for background only, around its 'profit_opportunity'/free-token discussion) uses the same relation and rationale ('token distribution must presuppose payment') with no discrepancy from the case JSON's actual annotation text.
